Without the options, my best guess is still palpation of the jugular venous pulse, since the JVP is assessed by inspection. The shared note is wrong: the JVP is read from the internal jugular vein, not the external, because the internal jugular runs in a straight line to the right atrium while the external has valves and is unreliable for estimating pressure.
